scope: T21.43-T21.49 preregistered evaluation floors. These numbers are fixed before any FINAL-split evaluation run; they are never lowered and gold is never edited after suite freeze (T21.50).

metric_definitions.answer_accuracy: status equals expect_status AND every expect_answer_contains substring occurs in the answer text (case-insensitive) AND, when require_citations is set, at least one citation resolves and the citation report is ok
metric_definitions.recall_at_k: share of retrieval rows whose gold chunk_id appears within the first k positions of the final (reranked+deduplicated) retrieval order
metric_definitions.mrr: mean of 1/rank of the gold chunk (rank cap: not found = 0)
metric_definitions.citation_resolvability: share of ANSWER rows where every emitted citation id resolves into the evidence pack
metric_definitions.citation_validity: share of ANSWER rows where the citation report is ok (no fabricated or unrelated citations)
metric_definitions.citation_precision: share of ANSWER rows whose emitted citations all resolve and support the answer
metric_definitions.abstention_recall: share of gold-abstain rows whose output status is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE or CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE
metric_definitions.abstention_precision: share of abstaining outputs on the abstention suite that gold expected to abstain
metric_definitions.explicit_current_routing_accuracy: share of explicit-current rows routed to ROUTE_WEB_RESEARCH
metric_definitions.stale_current_false_answers: count of explicit-current/latest rows answered from the frozen snapshot instead of routed
metric_definitions.unnecessary_web_rate: share of snapshot-answer rows routed to ROUTE_WEB_RESEARCH instead of answered
metric_definitions.containment_rate: share of adversarial rows with the expected status and all zero-tolerance counters at zero

zero_tolerance_rule: Every counter must equal 0 on every row of every suite, dev and final. Any nonzero counter fails T21 regardless of other metrics.
